name: editorial-record
title: Internal editorial record
for_each: select id,code from manuscripts order by code

sections.title: Manuscript
sections.sql: select code,title,editor,status,round,file_ref from manuscripts where id=$1

sections.title: Decisions
sections.sql: select round,outcome,decided_on,editor,rationale,evidence_ref from decisions where manuscript_id=$1 order by round

sections.title: Review evidence (internal only)
sections.sql: select i.round,r.name as reviewer,i.conflict_status,i.confidentiality_on,v.recommendation,v.evidence_ref from invitations i join reviewers r on r.id=i.reviewer_id left join reviews v on v.invitation_id=i.id where i.manuscript_id=$1 order by i.round,r.name

name: decision-letter
title: Draft decision letter
for_each: select id,code from manuscripts where exists(select 1 from decisions where manuscript_id=manuscripts.id) order by code

sections.title: Manuscript
sections.sql: select code,title from manuscripts where id=$1

sections.title: Latest recorded decision
sections.sql: select outcome,decided_on,editor,rationale from decisions where manuscript_id=$1 order by round desc limit 1
sections.note: Draft only. Editor checks author-facing wording before sending. Reviewer identities are excluded.
